visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image-top link cards with an eyebrow, heading, description and an icon-only CTA; slides horizontally on small screens, three across on desktop
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image-top cards with small-caps eyebrow, H3, description and an icon-only arrow/open-in-new link, 3 across in a slider.

contentPattern.description: Cards inside each tab panel (image, eyebrow, H3, description, icon link).
contentPattern.structure: One row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 eyebrow paragraph, H3, description, link
contentPattern.notes: Option tiles: text-only filled tiles (H3, description, link; no image) in a wrapping grid, 4 across from 1200px, 3 from 900px, 2 from 600px; the whole tile links out. Option links: same rows as tiles (H3, description, link) rendered as unfilled text links with a chevron, 2 across from 600px; put the block in a section with section-metadata style "split" to place the section intro (H2, text, CTA) beside it from 900px. Option grid: default rows (image; H3, description, link) as image-top cards in a wrapping grid, 4 across from 1200px, 3 from 900px, 2 from 600px; the whole card links out; a card without an image gets a sand placeholder.

usage.description: Image-top link cards with an eyebrow, heading, description and an icon-only CTA; slides horizontally on small screens, three across on desktop.

reuseGuidance: Use for linked cards with a category label. Use cards for plain image/text cards.
